title: How does a corporate wellness enrollment change the amount charged for a missed class?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states how the flat fee charged for a missed, uncancelled class booking is affected when the member also holds an active corporate wellness enrollment.

## Basis
A member who holds an active corporate wellness enrollment at the moment a no-show is logged has the tier's flat no-show fee reduced by a rate: specifically, the lower of the employer's own discount rate under that enrollment and this tier's own corporate wellness discount rate. The two rates are compared against each other, and only the lower one is used to reduce the fee — they are never summed and never applied in succession. Where the member does not hold an active corporate wellness enrollment at that moment, the full flat fee is charged with no reduction. The amount charged, whichever way it is determined, is rounded to two decimal places.

## Frequently confirmed points
Q: If a member's employer offers a smaller discount than the tier's own rate, which applies?
A: The employer's smaller rate applies, because the lower of the two rates always governs.
Q: What if the member's corporate wellness enrollment lapsed the day before the no-show was logged?
A: Because the enrollment is not active at the moment the no-show is logged, the full flat fee applies with no reduction.

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, a tier's flat no-show fee were $18.00, the tier's own corporate wellness discount rate were 6 percent, and an enrolled member's employer offered a 9 percent rate. Because 6 percent is the lower of the two, the fee actually charged is $18.00 reduced by 6 percent, rounded to two decimal places.

## Points of judgement
- The comparison is made fresh at the moment the no-show is logged, not at booking or at the class's scheduled time.
- Exactly one rate reduces the fee; there is no scenario in this basis where both rates apply together.
